raw_response: {"diagnosis": "Delivery batch 12 (349 rows, the only rows with source_tz='UTC') has txn_ts in UTC, while every other batch is in America/Chicago local time; for example, 12:01 UTC equals 06:01 CST, the usual opening time. The pipeline ignores source_tz, so about 99 evening transactions from 2026-01-16 roll over past UTC midnight into 2026-01-17 at 00:00-06:00, inflating that day's count and shrinking 2026-01-16.", "decision": "fix", "confidence": 0.85, "pre_sql": [], "step_overrides": {"silver_transactions": "CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE silver_transactions AS SELECT CAST(txn_id AS BIGINT) AS txn_id, customer_id, CAST(merchant_id AS INTEGER) AS merchant_id, CAST(amount AS DECIMAL(12,2)) AS amount, CAST(CASE WHEN source_tz = 'UTC' THEN timezone('America/Chicago', timezone('UTC', CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP))) ELSE CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) END AS TIMESTAMP) AS txn_ts, CAST(CAST(CASE WHEN source_tz = 'UTC' THEN timezone('America/Chicago', timezone('UTC', CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP))) ELSE CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) END AS TIMESTAMP) AS DATE) AS txn_date FROM raw_transactions WHERE status = 'POSTED'"}}
